description: extract_domain(email) extracts the domain between @ and .com/etc, but slicing misses the first character after @.

repo_files.emailutils.py:
def extract_domain(email: str) -> str:
    """Extract domain name from email (e.g. user@domain.com -> domain.com)."""
    if "@" not in email:
        return ""
    idx = email.index("@")
    # Bug: idx + 2 skips the first char of domain
    return email[idx + 2 :]
